mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_dict_data ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM t_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM t_dict_data WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM t_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dict_data (dict_type, dict_label, dict_value, css_class, list_class, is_default, sort_order, status, remark) VALUES (#{dictType}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, #{cssClass}, #{listClass}, #{isDefault}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_dict_data WHERE dict_label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR dict_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY sort_order, id
